sentences.text: Kåhlman Marine Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-22 under the industry code 33150, repair and maintenance of civilian ships and boats.
First sales, a start-up notification and a board change are all dated 2026-07-22.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
